fr_saurer_verb.en: to smoke herring in a chimney
ex: Il saure les harengs dans la cheminée.
He smokes the herrings in the chimney.
fr_saurer_verb.why: The stock gloss says smoke; the chimney keeps it food-smoking, not tobacco.
fr_saurer_verb.note: The picture shows him at a hot pot. The verb means to smoke herring in a chimney; the fish is not painted.
